entities.name: New Prahv
entities.description: Current guild hall of the Azorius Senate on Ravnica, tallest structure on the ground.

entities.name: Old Prahv
entities.description: Former guildhall destroyed in the Parhelion crash, now a nature preserve.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: Ravnican guild headquartered at New Prahv.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: Azorius guildmaster murdered at the guild summit.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: Artifact housed at New Prahv during the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker who tried to deactivate and later reignite the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: Planeswalker who helped deactivate the Sun.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: Posed as Chandra to trick Dovin.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: Planeswalker blinded by Lazav, escaped by planeswalking.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon prevented from planeswalking away.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Directed Realmbreaker to attack the Azorius Senate.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion that damaged the guild hall.

events.summary: The guild summit at the Senate House ends with the murder of guildmaster Isperia.
events.quote: ended with the murder of the Azorius guildmaster Isperia

events.summary: Chandra, Saheeli, Lazav and Lavinia enter New Prahv to deactivate the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: intending to deactivate the Immortal Sun

events.summary: Lazav, posing as Chandra, blinds Dovin Baan, who planeswalks to safety.
events.quote: Lazav blinded Dovin, but as the Immortal Sun was deactivated, Baan managed to planeswalk to safety

events.summary: Chandra reignites the Immortal Sun to stop Bolas planeswalking away.
events.quote: Chandra used her fire magic to reginite the Immortal Sun to prevent Bolas from planeswalking away

events.summary: Vraska directs Realmbreaker to attack the Azorius Senate, severely damaging the guild hall.
events.quote: The guild hall was severely damaged during the New Phyrexian Invasion

relations.quote: New Prahv is the current guild hall for the Azorius Senate on Ravnica
They tricked Dovin Baan by having Lazav pose as Chandra
